SELECT o.fault_category AS category, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM t_work_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.id = o.root_order_id AND o.create_time >= #{q.beginTime} AND o.create_time < #{q.endTime}
GROUP BY o.fault_category ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT AS d, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, o.create_time, o.finish_time))) AS avgMinutes, COUNT(1) AS orderCount FROM t_work_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.id = o.root_order_id AND o.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CLOSED') AND o.finish_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ORDER BY d
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_work_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.id = o.root_order_id AND o.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CLOSED')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.order_id) FROM t_order_acceptance a JOIN t_work_order o ON o.id = a.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.result = 'REJECT' AND a.create_time >= #{q.beginTime} AND a.create_time < #{q.endTime}

SELECT b.name AS buildingName, o.room_no AS roomNo, COUNT(1) AS reworkCount FROM t_order_acceptance a JOIN t_work_order o ON o.id = a.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 JOIN t_building b ON b.id = o.building_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.result = 'REJECT' AND a.create_time >= #{q.beginTime} AND a.create_time < #{q.endTime}
GROUP BY o.building_id, b.name, o.room_no ORDER BY reworkCount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT u.id AS repairerId, u.real_name AS repairerName, COUNT(o.id) AS finishCount, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN o.finish_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, COALESCE(o.assign_time, o.create_time), o.finish_time) END)) AS avgMinutes, ROUND(AVG(e.score), 2) AS avgScore FROM t_user u LEFT JOIN t_work_order o ON o.assignee_id = u.id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.id = o.root_order_id AND o.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CLOSED') AND o.finish_time IS NOT NULL
LEFT JOIN t_evaluation e ON e.order_id = o.id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.role = 'REPAIRER' AND u.status = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.real_name ORDER BY finishCount DESC, avgScore DESC, u.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('CREATED', 'ASSIGNED', 'ACCEPTED', 'ARRIVED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.timeout_flag = 1 AND o.status NOT IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS timeoutCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.create_time >= CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayNewCount, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CLOSED') AND o.finish_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, o.create_time, o.finish_time) END)) AS avgDurationMinutes, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CLOSED') AND o.is_rework = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reworkCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CLOSED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishedCount FROM t_work_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.id = o.root_order_id
